description: This source file defines a Roslyn analyzer class 'AtMostOneOrleansConstructorAnalyzer' that inspects C# class and struct declarations to ensure they have at most one constructor annotated for serialization, reporting diagnostics if violations are found.

classes.name: AtMostOneOrleansConstructorAnalyzer
classes.description: A Roslyn diagnostic analyzer that enforces a rule allowing at most one constructor marked for serialization in classes or structs.
